post.summary: Issue extension access and refresh tokens
post.description:
Issue a new scoped extension access and rotating refresh token for an authenticated user.

The user initiates sign-in from the browser/CLI, authenticating with Clerk, and this
endpoint registers the extension installation and issues DevMind-scoped tokens (ADR-012).

post.summary: Rotate extension refresh token and issue new access token
post.description:
Rotate an extension refresh token.

Issues a new access token and a new rotating refresh token.
If a previously rotated token is reused, the entire extension registration is
immediately revoked (replay detection per docs/07 §3).

post.summary: Record heartbeat for active extension installation
post.description: Record extension activity and verify token validity.

post.summary: Compute manifest diff against cloud Project Brain
post.description:
Compute manifest diff between client local files and current cloud Brain state.

Detects:
- New, changed, unchanged, and removed files.
- Missing files whose full symbol extractions must be uploaded.
- Stale base snapshot conflict (409 sync.stale_base).

post.summary: Upload consented and redacted code snippets
post.description:
Consented snippet upload with server-side redaction re-check (docs/03 §12.4, docs/07 §6).

Validation:
- Caller must possess 'project:sync' permission on project.
- Active, non-revoked consent required for 'snippet_transmission' scope matching consent_id.
- Excluded credential paths (.env, .pem, .key, id_rsa, etc.) are rejected with 422 even if sent.
- Snippet total size <= 2MB route ceiling.
- Server independently re-runs redaction across all snippet content, increasing redaction count if needed.
